Laura — good candidate for a short bridge. Finance will ok a one-off provisional credit under $10K for closed-lost pilots where the customer can show active evaluation work. Two notes:
1) We need confirmation of the project tag and a procurement email to attach to the HubSpot deal.
2) Mark the credit as conditional: if Syntora converts to a paid trial or committed capacity within 60 days, the credit stands; otherwise it will be recorded as a one-time courtesy.

Marissa — if you can handle the enablement checklist (temp keys, token limits, and expiration) I’ll prepare the approval memo and pass it to finance. I’ve added a stub HubSpot link for the deal in related_links.
